_description: Source-backed research index keyed by topic; each entry includes a summary and exact source URL.

iced.summary: The official Iced organization describes Iced as a cross-platform Rust GUI library inspired by Elm. This supports considering it for a desktop UI; no Archx performance benchmark has been run.

cosmic_iced.summary: System76's libcosmic describes itself as a platform toolkit based on Iced for COSMIC applets and applications.

tauri_webviews.summary: Tauri's official reference says it uses WebView2 on Windows and WebKit on macOS and Linux; the engine differs by platform. That alone does not establish that Tauri necessarily breaks cross-platform.

egui_repaint.summary: egui's official README describes it as immediate-mode but says it repaints on interaction or animation, not continuously while idle. Performance differences need measurement for the intended workload.

iced_0_14_api.summary: Official iced 0.14.0 release and tagged examples establish application(new/update/view), .font/.default_font, widget styling closures, subscriptions, and window screenshot tasks. Planned use: src/main.rs app startup; src/app.rs state, navigation and snapshot; src/home.rs layout; src/style.rs widget styles. No other UI framework.

iced_screenshot_api.summary: Tagged screenshot example uses window::latest().and_then(window::screenshot), screenshot rgba buffer, and image::save_buffer to PNG. Planned use: optional screenshot path for OS review only.

image_0_25.summary: Iced 0.14 Cargo manifest uses image 0.25; use its PNG encoding only for opt-in screenshots, not for homepage rendering.

manrope_font.summary: Manrope font and unmodified SIL OFL license from the Google Fonts repository; bundled for consistent desktop typography.

iced_styling.summary: Tagged styling example demonstrates container, button, layout and themes; use simple solid styles instead of expensive blur.

github_actions_workflows.summary: GitHub Actions workflow syntax and OS runner labels for cross-platform build/test automation; only build outputs required for review should be checked in under a dedicated location.

windows_gui_subsystem.summary: Rust Reference: the default Windows console subsystem creates/attaches a console; crate-level windows_subsystem="windows" runs a GUI process without a console. Use for Windows release builds in src/main.rs; verify PE subsystem in CI.

iced_embedded_image.summary: Iced 0.14 image widget with ContentFit::Cover, using a stable cached Handle for bundled PNG art; enable iced image feature. The official gallery example demonstrates image() and ContentFit.

epic_launcher_structure.summary: Epic support describes launcher navigation via Store and Library tabs/sidebars. Use only the broad launcher pattern: editorial feature and an app library, not Epic branding/assets or a copied UI.

iced_0_14_gradient_and_shadow.summary: Iced 0.14 core provides gradient::Linear with ordered stops, button::Style background/border/shadow, and Radians orientation. Used for a restrained native grey-glass selection pill; no blur shader or animation.

iced_0_14_image_cover.summary: Iced 0.14 gallery example uses image handles, ContentFit and border radius. Used to render bundled JPEG app cover art without runtime network requests.

pillow_tile_crop.summary: Pillow ImageOps.fit center-crops and resizes images to an exact aspect ratio. Used only as a local asset-preparation tool to normalize four app covers to 800×480; it is not a runtime dependency.

iced_0_14_window_icon.summary: Iced 0.14 application.window accepts window::Settings with icon. window::icon::from_file_data decodes embedded PNG into a native titlebar/taskbar icon on supported platforms. Window icon is separate from Windows executable icon resource.

iced_0_14_window_settings.summary: Window settings contain size and optional icon, passed through Application::window; tested on each native runner.

tauri_winres_0_3_7.summary: tauri-winres 0.3.7 WindowsResource::set_icon embeds ICO in PE, and set("CompanyName", ...) adds truthful version metadata. These do not provide Authenticode signing; target-specific build dependency only on Windows.

microsoft_signtool.summary: Microsoft SignTool signs, timestamps and verifies files with a trusted signing certificate. A company metadata field or image icon cannot replace a certificate. Do not claim the executable is signed pending verified Archnemix certificate and a secure signing method.

microsoft_artifact_signing_eligibility.summary: Official 2026 quickstart lists restricted country eligibility for Public Trust organization validation; Pakistan is not listed. This is only one possible provider. Need to confirm Archnemix legal entity location and obtain an appropriate identity-validated certificate/service before signing; do not assume eligibility or create fake self-signed publisher.

iced_0_14_hover_and_subscription.summary: Iced 0.14 mouse_area exposes on_enter/on_exit messages for a hovered text-only card, and Subscription::batch combines the existing snapshot timer with a hover-only animation tick. This does not imply click/navigation. Hover timer should stop on mouse exit or About.

iced_0_14_subscription_batch.summary: Iced 0.14 Subscription::batch combines independent subscriptions, allowing snapshot and hover animation timers to coexist.

iced_0_14_container_gradient.summary: Iced 0.14 container::Style::background accepts a native gradient Background; use for restrained Agent kinetic typography panel, not a shader or prerecorded image.

pillow_alpha_sidebar_crop.summary: Pillow Image.getchannel(A).getbbox finds nonzero alpha bounds and Image.crop preserves the transparent background. Used to derive a smaller faithful sidebar mark from the supplied source without black backing.

space_grotesk_font.summary: Google Fonts ofl/spacegrotesk provides 300–700 variable weight Space Grotesk by Florian Karsten with SIL OFL. Bundle for selective editorial headings and kinetic model-workspace words, while keeping Manrope for body/navigation and unchanged Agent wordmark.

iced_0_14_font_weight.summary: Iced 0.14 Font has Family::Name and Weight::Medium/Semibold; text::font selects a registered family for chosen roles. Register Space Grotesk bytes alongside Manrope, do not change default body family.

carbon_typographic_hierarchy.summary: Carbon productive headings use a restrained range of weights/sizes and distinguish headings from body; informs one emphasized display word per model card and lighter page/section headings rather than bold everywhere.

material_expressive_hierarchy.summary: Material 3 expressive guidance uses type weight/size and space to make key information editorial without adding decorative clutter; informs our two-family hierarchy and model card emphasis, not copied visual elements.

material_accessibility_contrast.summary: Material accessibility quotes W3C 4.5:1 small-text and 3:1 large-text contrast guidance; DIM was raised to #919191, measured 5.17:1 even against #202020 surface; other text roles remain brighter.

iced_0_14_numeric_token_types.summary: Iced 0.14 Pixels and Length implement From<f32> (and u32), while Padding implements From<f32> (and u16). Shared typography/spacing tokens must be f32 to work across Text::size, Space::height and Container::padding. Run 43227366516 showed u16 fails for size/height; corrected shared constants to f32.

iced_0_14_ui_skeleton.summary: Iced 0.14 widget APIs: button::on_press for native navigation, TextInput::new(placeholder,value) without on_input is disabled, and container/scrollable/row/column are native layout widgets. A disabled composer is preferable to simulating AI chat when no model/backend exists.

iced_0_14_button_navigation.summary: Iced button on_press(message) sends a message on activation; selected navigation reuses existing native button styling. No new chat persistence or model runtime is implied by UI state.

iced_0_14_disabled_text_input_style.summary: Iced TextInput::Style has background, border, icon, placeholder, value and selection; the default Disabled status uses a brighter weak surface and dark placeholder. A custom disabled class can retain no on_input while styling the faux composer to the Lab charcoal surface and legible muted placeholder.

iced_0_14_editable_unsent_draft.summary: Iced 0.14 TextInput::new copies placeholder/current value; .on_input emits String updates but .on_submit is independent and can be omitted to prevent submission. Button::on_press_maybe(None) disables an unavailable action. TextInput::Style status includes Focused { is_hovered }, so a focused silver border can aid input navigation while keeping a dark surface. Dependencies: iced 0.14 already in Cargo.toml; no storage/backend crate.

iced_0_14_optional_button_event.summary: Button::on_press_maybe accepts Option<Message>; None means no action. Use for Clear when no text, and keep Send unbound until a model/backend is intentionally designed.

iced_0_14_collapsible_lab_rail.summary: Iced button.on_press emits a toggle message; widget image.width/height/content_fit shrink the transparent brand mark; row.align_y and Length keep compact/full rails in one native layout. No new library needed.

openrouter_free_variants.summary: OpenRouter models API exposes IDs/pricing, and :free is a separate catalog variant with its own rate limits. Paid fallbacks can be billed, so never silently fall back to paid from :free.

xai_chat_completions.summary: xAI documents https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions with Bearer auth and a model ID; exact model support must be discovered from provider rather than hardcoded stale Grok IDs.

gemini_interactions_catalog.summary: Gemini lists distinct model IDs/capabilities; user-typed model IDs should remain possible because provider catalogs and availability change. Must verify current REST list endpoint and auth before implementation.

rust_keyring_storage_caveats.summary: The keyring crate documentation describes platform credential stores; newer core/store backends may be needed for deliberate Windows/macOS/Linux semantics. OS credential storage protects at rest, but a key must briefly be plaintext in process memory for an HTTP request; scattered-memory security cannot be guaranteed. Verify backend availability and fail closed before implementing.

owasp_secrets_lifecycle.summary: OWASP recommends least-privilege access, lifecycle rotation/revocation, and never logging secrets. App will use OS credential stores, short-lived reads, explicit deletion, redacted errors, no plaintext config/log files; OS user-session compromise remains a caveat.

microsoft_credential_manager.summary: Microsoft recommends CredWrite/CredRead in Windows Credential Manager for app credentials, collecting late and discarding early, avoiding hardcoded/plaintext/logged secrets. Windows same-user process access remains a caveat; no verified publisher is implied.

apple_keychain_generic.summary: Apple Keychain Services supports generic-password items and SecItemAdd/SecItemCopyMatching; native keyring implementation uses Keychain service/account entries. Unsigned developer builds may prompt for access; do not promise Secure Enclave for retrievable API keys.

freedesktop_secret_service.summary: Secret Service stores secrets in a user login service, uses sessions for transfer, and may require unlock prompts. Linux GUI may have no Secret Service; fail closed rather than falling back to plaintext or unprotected keyutils.

keyring_v4_2_platform_impl.summary: keyring 4.2 v1 Entry::new/set_password/get_password/delete_credential defaults to Apple Keychain, Windows Credential store and zbus Secret Service on Linux. It does not use a plaintext fallback. Verify real storage on user desktop; three-OS CI can only prove compilation and fake-store tests.

fluent2_navigation_toggle.summary: Fluent 2 Nav advises a predictable collapse/expand affordance and explicit Expand navigation/Collapse navigation labels; use a stable bottom-aligned labelled button in both states, not a cramped button alongside the logo.

atlassian_nav_space.summary: Atlassian layout guidance reserves distinct compact and expanded side-nav widths; avoid placing full text controls in compact width.

iced_rail_buttons.summary: Iced 0.14 button on_press emits rail toggle; column height(Fill) and space height(Fill) anchor toggle at bottom while preserving native button focus.

openrouter_chat_rest.summary: OpenRouter POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with Bearer and JSON model/messages/max_tokens; :free is a distinct variant, not a generic free flag. No unrequested fallbacks.

xai_chat_rest.summary: xAI documents POST https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions with Bearer and JSON model/messages; avoid assuming a particular model is always offered.

gemini_generate_rest.summary: Gemini REST models/{model}:generateContent accepts contents text parts and generationConfig maxOutputTokens; authentication via x-goog-api-key as documented in Gemini text generation.

gemini_rest_auth.summary: Gemini text generation REST uses an x-goog-api-key header for a direct HTTPS call; no key in URL or logs.

reqwest_0_12_client.summary: reqwest 0.12 ClientBuilder supports timeout, https_only, redirect policy and no_proxy; use fixed HTTPS origins, reject redirects and sanitize network errors. Verified tagged source in GitHub.

iced_0_14_secret_input.summary: Iced 0.14 TextInput::secure(true) masks rendered text. Entered key is still transiently in widget/event/app memory and is not protected from same-process inspection.

lucide_rail_icons.summary: Lucide provides consistent 24px outlined SVG icons. Pin only six local files (house, message-circle, info, settings-2, panel-left-open/close) to commit 55782beff3a0133df79c417eb68f96e8f19e2404; bundle the upstream LICENSE rather than loading assets at runtime.

iced_0_14_svg_icon.summary: Iced 0.14 SVG widget accepts in-memory Handle and sized vector content; svg::Style color filter recolors symbolic icons according to selected/idle palette. Enable iced svg feature.

iced_0_14_tooltip.summary: Iced 0.14 Tooltip::new wraps a control with hover hint; Position::Right and gap keep icon-only rail labels available without squeezing text into 92px. Tooltip does not substitute for verified screen-reader semantics.

fluent2_nav_labels.summary: Fluent 2 suggests predictable expand/collapse affordance, recognisable icons, brief labels and tooltip on the right of truncated nav. Its web Nav explicitly does not itself support icon-only; our purpose-built native Iced rail must retain tooltips and keyboard-focus testing rather than treating this as a direct component copy.
